_doc: 15 §C (technical output spec and delivery sizes), §D1 (naming), §D2 (atlas grouping), §A5 (biome palettes and rarity colours), §E1–§E21 (the enumerations); 22 Parts A and B (the 98 perk and 60 talent symbol descriptors, which 15 §E12/§E13 delegate there); 08 §1 (the 6 gear slots × 4 families that 15 §E11 delegates there). One row per asset slot. 🔒 Counts are transcribed, never reconciled: where a section's row count disagrees with 15 §E1, the disagreement is recorded in `discrepancies` for O30 at M11-01.

technical.pivotRule: Characters: bottom-center. Icons: center. Declared in the atlas metadata.

totals._doc: `claimedBySummaryTable` is 15 §E1's stated TOTAL. `transcribed` is what this file actually holds. They differ by 1 — see discrepancies DSC_E20_COUNT / DSC_E1_TOTAL. `active` = transcribed − cut.

atlases.contents: That biome's enemies, elites, boss, tiles, board pieces, decor
The die body and all 11 face artworks

notes: §E4 states '16 elites × 2 poses' but does not name the two poses. `idle`/`attack` are carried from §E3, the only section that names a two-pose set.
§D2's `atlas_biome_{n}` lists 'tiles', but these 14 icons are shared across biomes and engine-tinted per biome, so they cannot be members of eight per-biome atlases. Atlas omitted pending a ruling.
The 6 path pieces per biome are enumerated by §E9. The 8 decor props per biome are a count plus a prose list of kinds, with no ids — those 64 rows are derived:true.
§C states 1080×1440 for the biome battle backdrops only. It states no size for the four scene backgrounds, so theirs is ABSENT (S6).
§D2: 'Backgrounds are not atlased (they are full-screen and streamed per biome).'

§E11 gives no per-item descriptor. §E2's family-descriptor table covers only the 12 weapon/helmet/armor families; the boots, ring and amulet families have none, so 60 of the 120 rows carry no subject at all (S6).

§E16's prose names a die BODY reused for every face, and §D2's `atlas_dice` says 'the die body and all 11 face artworks'. §E1 and §E16 both count 11 (faces only). The body is uncounted and has no id, so no row is authored for it.

Four sub-groups give a count with no individual ids and are derived:true: the 6 category card frames, the 10 decorative dividers/ribbons/banners, and the 4 toast chrome pieces. The ROLL and ad buttons are '3 states' unnamed; normal/pressed/disabled are carried from the four named button variants.
§C: 'UI panels & frames — variable, 9-slice', so deliverySize is omitted.

sections.cut: D14 — cosmetics cut from v1, ruled in 15 §E18
notes: 🔒 Cut by decision D14. Zero assets, so there is no row to carry a cut flag — the cut is recorded on this section. Represented consistently with E19: both sections carry a `cut` string; E19 additionally carries 32 cut rows because its assets were enumerated before the ruling.

🔒 All 32 rows carry cut='O8 — procedural in-engine, ruled 2026-08-12'. The rows are retained so the post-cut total is derivable from the data rather than asserted. Atlas `atlas_vfx` (§D2) consequently has no uncut contents.

⚠️ §E20's heading and its lead-in both say 'Counted individually (50)', but the list that follows holds 49 items. The 49 listed are transcribed; no 50th is invented. This is the whole of the §E1 total's 975-vs-974 gap.
§C states no delivery size for misc UI icons, and §D2 names no atlas for them.
§D1 authorises no prefix for store art, so every id here is convention-derived. The assets themselves are individually enumerated by §E21, so derived is false.
The wordmark is engine-set type, not AI-generated (§E21, §A3).

discrepancies.detail: The §E20 heading and lead-in both say 50; the '·'-separated list holds 49. The 49 are transcribed and no 50th is invented. Reconciling the manifest totals is O30's job at M11-01, so this is recorded, not fixed.
§E1's own per-section counts sum to exactly 975, so the summary table is internally consistent; the single-asset gap is entirely DSC_E20_COUNT.

discrepancies.claim: 975 → 943 after cutting the 32 E19 VFX sheets
discrepancies.detail: The ruling's 943 is 975−32. Because the transcribed total is 974 (see DSC_E20_COUNT), the data yields 942 uncut rows. Both numbers are derivable from this file; neither has been adjusted to match the other.

discrepancies.claim: §D2 atlas_dice: 'The die body and all 11 face artworks' (12 assets)
discrepancies.detail: §E16's prose states the die body is a single asset reused for every face, but gives it no id and does not count it. No row is authored for it, because doing so would silently move the section total from 11 to 12.
The `_default` suffix is a leftover of the die-skin system cut by D14. §E16's ids are transcribed as written.

discrepancies.observed: the two poses are never named
discrepancies.detail: idle/attack are carried from §E3, the only section naming a two-pose set. §E5, §E6 and §E7 all name theirs explicitly, so the omission is specific to §E4.

discrepancies.observed: §E8's 14 tile icons are shared and engine-tinted per biome
discrepancies.detail: Fourteen shared icons cannot be members of eight per-biome atlases without being duplicated eight times, which §E1's count of 14 rules out. Atlas is null for §E8 pending a ruling.

discrepancies.observed: §E20 misc UI icons and §E21 store art are assigned to none
discrepancies.detail: atlas_ui's contents are 'Panels, buttons, frames, currency icons' — the 49 misc UI icons are not named. Both sections carry atlas:null.

discrepancies.observed: 0 uncut assets after the O8 ruling
discrepancies.detail: Every member of atlas_vfx is cut, so the atlas has no contents. It is retained in the atlases block with uncutAssetCount 0 rather than deleted, because §D2 still declares it.

discrepancies.observed: no row for §E20 misc UI icons, and none covering §E10's 4 scene backgrounds
discrepancies.detail: Those rows omit deliverySize rather than borrow a value (S6); the reader surfaces the absence as null. §E21's sizes come from §E21's own table, not §C.
